sentences.text: Wellbore 15/9-F-11 T2 (Sodir wellbore 7078) has drilling reports from 2013-03-23 to 2013-05-14, a report span of 52.96 days with 53 active days.
The report period forms 1 campaign.
Total depth is 4562.0 m measured depth per Sodir; the deepest reported measured depth is 4562.1 m, at a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m.
Total activity time is 1230.5 h, of which primary lost time is 145.0 h, or 11.78% of activity time.

The main outcome is that the 8.5 in section reached 4562.1 m MD on 2013-05-08; the well was then cement-plugged and kicked off on 2013-05-14 to the F-11 A sidetrack, and operations were transferred there.
Sodir gives a completion date of 2013-05-12, which is earlier than the last report date because the cement plug was tagged on 2013-05-12 and the kick-off ran on 2013-05-14.
The Sodir entry date is 2013-03-07, before the first drilling report.
The well has one campaign, campaign 1, from 2013-03-23 to 2013-05-14.
Campaign 1 spans 52.96 days with 53 active days, and its dominant operation phase is drilling.
Four hole sections are listed in drilling order.

Section 1 is 26.0 in hole from 257.0 m to 1365.0 m MD (TVD 1340.5 m at section end), drilled from 2013-03-23 to 2013-04-12, with 1108.0 m of new hole, an average rate of 16.0 m/h while coded drilling, and 474.5 h of activity.

Section 2 is 17.5 in hole from 1368.0 m to 2577.0 m MD (TVD 2444.0 m at section end), drilled from 2013-04-13 to 2013-04-27, with 1212.0 m of new hole, an average rate of 14.87 m/h while coded drilling, and 360.0 h of activity.

Section 3 is 8.5 in hole from 2577.0 m to 4562.1 m MD (TVD 3398.2 m at section end), drilled from 2013-04-28 to 2013-05-08, with 1985.1 m of new hole, an average rate of 14.0 m/h while coded drilling, and 264.0 h of activity.

Section 4 has no hole size reported (hole size source unknown); it runs from 4562.0 m to 4562.1 m MD (TVD 3398.2 m at section end), was drilled from 2013-05-09 to 2013-05-14, drilled no new hole so no drilling rate is reported, and has 132.0 h of activity.
Section 1 starts below a casing shoe at 202.3 m and sets casing with its shoe at 1357.7 m; the activity comment records the casing as "20" casing string".
Section 2 starts below the 1357.7 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 2570.7 m; the activity comment records the casing as "RIH 14" 169.65 kg/m csg".
Section 3 starts below the 2570.7 m shoe and sets no casing.
Section 4 starts below the same 2570.7 m shoe and sets no casing; its casing shoe is not reported.
Primary lost time by section: section 1 has 58.5 h, or 12.33% of its 474.5 h activity time; section 2 has 86.5 h, or 24.03% of its 360.0 h activity time; sections 3 and 4 have no primary lost time.
Primary lost time by cause: weather waits total 74.0 h and equipment repair totals 71.0 h, which together make the 145.0 h wellbore total, or 11.78% of the 1230.5 h total activity time.
Possible lost time is reported separately and is not added to the primary figures: 152.25 h in total, or 12.37% of activity time.
Possible lost time by section: section 1 has 118.75 h (25.03% of its activity time), section 2 has 7.0 h (1.94%), section 3 has 7.75 h (2.94%) and section 4 has 18.75 h (14.2%).
Possible lost time by cause: maintenance 73.25 h, other 46.25 h and waiting 32.75 h.
On 2013-03-23 a gyro survey attempt was a no-go, a 0.5 h primary repair entry.
On 2013-03-24 the crown block fast-line sheave bearing was found seized, a 4.0 h possible-tier interruption that led to pulling the top-hole BHA.
On 2013-03-25 a stand of drill pipe was released from the elevators during the trip out, a 2.0 h primary repair entry.
The fast-line sheave was then replaced in the derrick from 2013-03-25 to 2013-03-28; the 8.0 h sheave repair on 2013-03-27 is a possible-tier entry.
On 2013-03-28 the BHA was picked up again over 7.75 h (primary), and the bit was stung into the conductor housing funnel, a 0.5 h primary repair entry.
On 2013-03-29 a restriction could not be passed on the run in hole, a 1.5 h primary repair entry.
The pipe deck machine failed and was repaired in 3.5 h (primary) on 2013-04-02, with a further 3.0 h on 2013-04-03 to replace a solenoid valve.
On 2013-04-04 a casing joint with damaged box threads was laid down and a backup wellhead was made up, a 6.0 h primary repair entry.
Riser work followed: on 2013-04-06 the riser flange studs were too long, a 5.5 h possible-tier wait, and on 2013-04-07 a missing riser o-ring was found, a 6.0 h possible-tier wait.
The riser guide funnel was recovered for repair on 2013-04-08 (3.0 h, primary) and reinstalled on 2013-04-09 (4.0 h, primary).
Weather waits to back-load cuttings were long: 16.0 h on 2013-04-15 and 15.5 h on 2013-04-19, both primary.
On 2013-04-24 a drawworks failure during the casing run cost 5.0 h of primary repair time.
On 2013-05-05 a pull-out of the 8.5 in BHA was a no-go with overpull, taking 2.0 h of drilling trip time.
On 2013-05-08 the BHA could not be pulled past tight spots and stalled; reaming and working the string took 5.25 h.
A cement plug was placed from 2013-05-10 (1.5 h of cement job time), a 12.25 h possible-tier wait on cement that included the BOP test ran on 2013-05-11, and hard cement was tagged on 2013-05-12.
On 2013-05-14 the well was kicked off to the F-11 A sidetrack by drilling through cement for 1.0 h, and operations were transferred to F-11 A.
Inspect and test the crown block fast-line sheave before the top-hole run: its bearing failure on 2013-03-24 cost 4.0 h and led to a repair that ran into 2013-03-28.

Plan cuttings handling capacity before the 17.5 in section: weather waits to back-load cuttings were 74.0 h of primary lost time, and cuttings-transfer restrictions slowed section 2 to 14.87 m/h while coded drilling.
Check riser flange studs and o-rings before running riser joints: the stud-length wait on 2013-04-06 (5.5 h) and the o-ring wait on 2013-04-07 (6.0 h) were both possible-tier time.
Inspect casing connections on the pipe rack and keep a backup wellhead ready: a casing joint with damaged box threads on 2013-04-04 cost 6.0 h of primary repair.
Before pulling the 8.5 in BHA, condition the hole and monitor overpull: the pull-out no-go on 2013-05-05 (2.0 h) and the tight spots on 2013-05-08 (5.25 h) both occurred in section 3.
Plan the plug and kick-off as a separate, recorded step: the cement tag on 2013-05-12 and the kick-off on 2013-05-14 explain why the Sodir completion date of 2013-05-12 precedes the last report.
Limit gyro survey runs in the top hole: the gyro attempt on 2013-03-23 was a 0.5 h no-go, and gyro runs were repeated in the 26.0 in section.

row.comments: Attempted to take MWD Gyro trac survey, no-go.

Checked crown block fast-line sheave and found bearing ceased onto shaft. Evaluated situation and informed offshore and onshore managment. Prepared forward plan to POOH 26" BHA prior to working on fast-line sheave. Barriered off rig floor and cantelever.

Meanwhile:
Circulated well 1100 l/min, 8 bar, 20 RPM, 2 kNm. Attempted to apply lubricant to fast-line sheave.

Prepared POOH from bottom at 453 m. Installed grease pump in crown block. Oriented 26" steering BHA.  Displaced well to 1.35 sg KCl mud, 1100 - 3100 l/min, 8 - 70 bar. Confirmed barriered off rig floor and cantelever. POOH from 454 m, recorded overpull of 30 tons. Broke circulation 650 l/min, 10 bar, 40 RPM, 15 kNm. POOH up through tight spot from 454 to 438 m. Stand of 5 1/2" DP mistakenly released from elevators while still connected in rotary.
Prepared for changing out fast-line sheave in crown block. Visually inspected top drive, hung off top drive, rigged down wireline equipment.

Repaired failed fast line sheave and re-assembled bearing assembly. 

Meanwhile: Performed service and visual inspection of forward and aft Pipe Racking System. Continued BOP annular repair. Tested backup MWD tools. Serviced TDS travelling block and dolly. Repaired TDS hangoff wire.

Continued installing fast-line sheave in derrick.

Meanwhile: Repaired leakage on BOP annular function. Prepared to function test same.
Picked up and made up 26" bottom hole assembly to 140m.
Stung 26" bit into conductor housing funnel and ran in hole with 26" bottom hole assembly from 140m MD to 152m MD. Informed production supervisor - ready to start up F-14 production.
Ran in hole with 26" bottom hole assembly on 5 1/2" drill pipe from 230m MD to 406m MD. Observed resistance at 406m MD. Attempted to pass restriction with 10MT - no go.

Troubleshoot and repaired Pipedeck Machine (PDM). Found tilt function and boom extension not working.

Meanwhile: Performed general maintanence.

Troubleshoot and repaired PDM (Pipe Deck Machine) Replaced solenoid valve.

Meanwhile: Performed general maintenance.

Broke out wellhead from string and laid down same to deck.
Pulled out of hole with 20" casing string from 1208 m to 1195 m and broke out joint with damaged box threads, laid down same to deck.
Picked up and made up new 20" casing joint and ran in hole to 1208 meter.
Changed to 5 1/2" handling equipment.
Prepared backup wellhead on HTS, made up same to running tool.
Picked up and made up backup wellhead assembly.
Installed  plug set in backup wellhead assembly.

Not able to make up flange between riser joints due to studs too long.
Technical Team fabricated spacer washer for shimming hydraulic jacks.

Meanwhile:
Rigged up wires for guide line system in moonpool.
Prepared next riser joints on cantilever deck.

Broke out connection between riser joints #6 and #3 and inspected same.
Found o-ring missing.
Installed o-ring in outer groove.
Made up connection between riser joints #6 and #3 and re-tested same to 35 bar, test ok.

Performed pre-job meeting.
Recovered riser guide funnel to surface for inspection and repair.
Launched and installed riser guide funnel on WHH.

Waited on weather.
Not able to back load cuttings from ISO tanks to supply vessel due to heavy wind and sea.

Meanwhile:
Circulated with 1440 liter/min, 35 bar.
Picked up and racked back 5 1/2" DP, 23 stands racked back.

Waited on weather to back load cuttings.

Meanwhile:
Circulated with 1420 lpm,  33 bar, 0 rpm.
RIH 14" 169.65 kg/m csg from 33 m to 327 m filling every joint with 1.42 sg OBM. Average running speed 6 jts./hr.

Troubleshoot drawwork failure.

Meanwhile: 
Removed auto slips and lowered 14" casing hanger below rotary in a controlled sequence, Up/Dw weight 430/320 MT. Installed master bushing and made up circulation swedge. Circulated with 200 lpm, 9 bar, 14" casing shoe at 2433 m.

Attempted to pull out of hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 3058m MD - no go. Observed 20MT overpull. Established circulation at 1800 lpm and 140 bar. Worked string until clear of restrictions.

Pulled out of hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 4562m MD to 4467m MD. Took 5MT overpull at 4467m MD. Attempted to pass restriction several times with maximum 30MT - no go. Attempted to run in hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly with up to 40 MT - no go. Established circulation with 1300 lpm and 54 bar, no losses. Attempted to establish rotation - no go. 

Applied full string weight, and established rotation. Reamed stand down from 4467m MD to 4482m MD. Attempted to ream stand up several times - no go. Stalled out at 4467m MD.
Stopped rotation and circulation and attempted to pull 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly out of hole from 4467m MD - no go. Established rotation with 50 rpm. Got passed restriction.

Pulled / reamed out of hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 4467m MD to 4407m MD with 1400 lpm, 31 bar, 50 rpm and 16-30 kNm. Observed tight spots at 4468m and 4460m.

Pumped 11.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Mixed and pumped 10 m3 of 1.90 sg cement slurry. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 890 l of drill water. Reset stroke counters. Pumped 2.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Displaced the cement with 40.6 m3 (1833 strokes) of 1.32 sg OBM. Underdisplaced with 2.5m3.

Rotated with 20 rpm and 15 kNm during displacement.

Waited on cement.

Meanwhlie: Performed prejob meeting prior to pick up and make up BOP test tool. Removed PS21 slips and installed master bushings. Picked up and made up BOP test tool, removed protective tape and inspected seals. Ran in hole with BOP test tool on 5 1/2" drill pipe to wellhead at 138m MD. Displaced riser and surface lines to sea water.

Pressure tested BOP to 345 bar.  Pressure tested standpipe manifold to 345 bar.

Displaced BOP to surface to 1.32 sg OBM. Pulled out of hole with BOP test tool on 5 1/2" drill pipe from 138 m MD. Broke out and laid down same.

Troubleshooting on top drive encoder. Function tested same. Function tested 3 1/2" auto slips. Performed general maintanence and housekeeping.
Washed in hole with 3 1/2" cement stinger on 5 1/2" drill pipe from 4044m MD to 4104m MD with 200 lpm and 20 bar. Tagged hard cement at 4104 with 10MT.

Kicked off to F-11 A by drilling from 2578m MD to 2586m MDwith 1800 lpm, 120 bar and 60 rpm. 50% cement / formation in returns verified at 2586m MD.

****Transferred operations to F-11 A****
